<repaired_code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
const ll MOD = 1000000007;

// Calculate sum of digits of n in base k
ll digitSum(ll n, ll k) {
    ll sum = 0;
    while (n > 0) {
        sum += n % k;
        n /= k;
    }
    return sum;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    ll n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    
    // Generate the sequence a0, a1, ..., an-1
    // where ai = digitSum(i, k)
    vector<ll> a(n);
    for (ll i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        a[i] = digitSum(i, k);
    }
    
    // Count distinct subsequences using dynamic programming
    // dp[i] = number of distinct subsequences ending with value i
    // We use a map to track the last occurrence contribution
    vector<ll> dp(1000001, 0); // Max possible digit sum for reasonable n and k
    ll total = 1; // Empty subsequence
    
    for (ll i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        ll val = a[i];
        ll prevCount = dp[val];
        dp[val] = (dp[val] + total) % MOD;
        total = (total + (dp[val] - prevCount + MOD) % MOD) % MOD;
    }
    
    // Subtract 1 to exclude the empty subsequence if needed
    // But problem says empty sequence is a subsequence, so we include it
    cout << (total - 1 + MOD) % MOD << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
